patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and PrestaShop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Lightspeed Retail only if your buying job matches “Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspe” rather than PrestaShop's shape. Choose PrestaShop only if your buying job matches “Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 1” rather than Lightspeed Retail's shape. Workflow advantage: Lightspeed Retail leans omnichannel-retail; PrestaShop leans catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lightspeed Retail and PrestaShop share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lightspeed Retail is Retail POS + omnichannel — Basic $89/mo, Core $149 highlighted, Plus $289/mo USD; Lightspeed Payments ~1.5% card-present; eCommerce on highe; PrestaShop is Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 14-day trial; Enterprise quote. WooCommerce keeps t.
- Workflow coverage skew: Lightspeed Retail-leaning omnichannel-retail vs PrestaShop-leaning catalog-management.
- Researched limits: Lightspeed Retail — No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; PrestaShop — Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free.

Limitations — Lightspeed Retail: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path; Third-party payment processors may incur a high monthly surcharge versus Lightspeed Payments (~1.5% card-present) — confirm live; PrestaShop: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; POS / omnichannel is module-dependent, not a native retail bundle.

Poor-fit cases: Lightspeed Retail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan or documented self-serve trial — contact sales is the common path · PrestaShop is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free · Avoid Lightspeed Retail if you actually need PrestaShop's motion (Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. V)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
